transcript_v2.video_summary: An off-camera interviewer stops a woman reading outside a bookstore to ask how she reads so much. She demonstrates the Listenify app on her phone, which scans book pages and reads them aloud. She shows how she can adjust the reading speed and switch to celebrity voices like Gwyneth Paltrow and Snoop Dogg, explaining how the app helps her read more and study for exams while on the go.
transcript_v2.scene_context: The video is an advertisement disguised as a spontaneous street interview. An older woman is sitting outdoors at a table with books. The interviewer approaches from behind the camera, holding a small lavalier microphone into the frame. The woman holds her smartphone, actively demonstrating the Listenify app interface as it reads a scanned page aloud.
